Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

UNTESTED - original theorycraft built as deliberate insurance rather than as a damage maximiser. The meta Shred build is excellent right now but rests on two things Maxroll itself flags as bugs: the Storm Shepherd set's dominance is partly attributed to bugs, and clicking Shred rather than holding it re-triggers the Waxing Gibbous 2-set bonus, which Maxroll calls a mechanical exploit. Exploits get patched. The question this build asks is whether the durable part of the Druid meta - the Berú of the Storm Shepherd rule that damage scales with Spirit regeneration rate - can be harvested by a Storm skill that does not depend on the Shred click interaction at all. Lightning Storm is the candidate: Icy Veins independently rates it S tier, it is already in the meta build's own skill bar as an Orange Herald trigger, and it is a ranged toggle, which also sidesteps Druid's named survivability weakness. If the Shred interaction is patched, this build should be roughly unaffected; if it is not, this build is probably a modest downgrade. That trade is the entire point.

Rotation
  1. Hurricane and Lightning Storm toggled on, group with Azurewrath, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, then kite the pack from range while the storms work.
  2. Refresh Debilitating Roar before it drops and save Earthen Bulwark for the big hit.
  3. No melee exposure, no rapid-clicking.
Variants

Leveling — Hurricane on, Cyclone Armor up, Lightning Storm into packs from range. Wind Shear when Spirit runs out. Stay at range - the whole reason for this build is not being in melee.
Move on when Level 70 with Torment 1 unlocked, and a Berú (Red Wolf Moon as the stand-in) equipped so you can start measuring.

Early Endgame — Hurricane and Lightning Storm toggled on, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, Debilitating Roar refreshed before it drops, Earthen Bulwark before you take a big hit. Note what is absent: no rapid-clicking, no Waxing Gibbous re-trigger, no melee exposure. Run test one here - verify the set scaling actually applies to Lightning Storm before you invest further.
Move on when Test one passed: adding a large Spirit regeneration source visibly increases Lightning Storm's damage. If it did not, stop here and play druid-meta-shred.

Late Endgame — Toggles up, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, kite. Charms: Azurewrath and Godslayer Crown for grouping, Rustbitten Dirk for lair bosses. Mercenary: Raheir with Aldkin as reinforcement - lean defensive, since the whole build is a durability play. Run test two and test three here: Pit clear time and deaths per run, both against druid-meta-shred at matched gear.
Move on when Test two and three recorded. Proceed to pushing regardless of the result - the decisive test is test four, which only happens after the next balance patch.

Pushing — Group with Azurewrath, toggles up, Grizzly Rage, kite the pack while Lightning Storm and Hurricane work. Set an honest expectation: Maxroll rates Lightning Storm A tier for push against Shred's S, so a one-to-two-tier gap versus druid-meta-shred is the expected outcome, not a failure. The build wins its argument only if it holds that position after the next patch while the Shred exploit is fixed.

Uniques
  • pants No dedicated boss this season — Season 14 moved it off boss loot tables. Farm it via the Horadric Cube: Common pants + 1 Enhanced Primordial Dust + 10 Primordial Dust rerolls into a random pants-slot unique; save duplicates for the 3-identical-uniques 'Recycle' recipe to push toward better affixes. Where →
  • offhand Target-farm The Beast in the Ice, an Initiate-tier Lair boss (1 Lair Key, Torment 1+ required). Where →
  • ring Target-farm Astaroth, the Escalating Nightmare Dungeon finale boss (costs 1 Escalation Sigil), then craft to Mythic via the Horadric Cube (4 Pandemonium Fragments) or the Jeweler — this build's crafted-Mythic priority, since Ifeh's Dire Totem is not needed here. Where →
  • ring Target-farm Lord Zir, an Initiate-tier Lair boss (1 Lair Key, Torment 1+ required) — he is the dedicated Druid source for this ring. Where →

Point allocation, in order69 points across 6 nodes

Constructed by the specialist, not copied from a guide - untested, like the rest of this build. Every node name here is one Maxroll's Season 14 planner data confirms for Druid; what is original is the distribution, which pours into Lightning Storm the points the meta build pours into Shred. Levelling here is a genuine gamble and worth saying so: Maxroll's Druid levelling route runs Shred, Rabies and Cataclysm, none of which this build keeps.

Skill point priority

  1. Lightning Storm to max - unlike the meta build, it is your actual damage skill from the start
  2. Wind Shear for Spirit generation
  3. Hurricane early for Weaken, Spirit and movement speed
  4. Cyclone Armor for damage reduction
  5. Debilitating Roar for survivability
  6. Grizzly Rage as the ultimate, though it matters less here than for a Werewolf build

Constructed by the specialist, not copied from a guide - untested, like the rest of this build. Every node name here is one Maxroll's Season 14 planner data confirms for Druid; what is original is the distribution, which pours into Lightning Storm the points the meta build pours into Shred.

Taken to maximum, where the meta build runs it at 1. Hurricane is this build's Weaken source, its Spirit restoration and part of its damage - not a utility toggle.

Unstoppable over Overpower deliberately: the PocQue rune loop feeds Tibault's Will, and Tibault's Will is Spirit regeneration, which under the Berú set is damage.

Skill point priority

  1. Lightning Storm max
  2. Hurricane max - it is the primary in-combat Spirit regeneration source now that you are not attacking constantly in melee, which makes it more load-bearing here than in the meta build
  3. Earthen Bulwark via the Que rune for Barrier and Unstoppable, feeding Tibault's Will
  4. Cyclone Armor kept rather than dropped - the ranged build can afford the slot the meta build spends on Shred
  5. Debilitating Roar for the Dark Howl bonus damage and defence
  6. Grizzly Rage for the multiplier

Board & glyph focus

Rush Legendary Nodes, then glyphs. Spirit and Earth and Sky first here rather than Fang and Claw, which is melee-synergistic and does little for a ranged build. Spirit Boons: Gift of the Stag on Deer for the Spirit regeneration that feeds the Berú scaling, Iron Feather on Eagle for defence, Calamity on Wolf, Calm Before the Storm on Bonded Snake for cooldown reduction.

How to run them

Raheir hired with Ground Slam, Bastion, Iron Wolf's Virtue and Raheir's Aegis, exactly as every Shred Druid profile does - Valiance's cheat-death is not something a Druid gives up this season. The reinforcement is where this build reasons differently from the meta one. The meta build takes Varyana for Bloodthirst attack speed because it wins by clicking Shred faster; this build has no attack-speed scaling at all, since Lightning Storm and Hurricane tick on their own timers. So the attack speed is close to worthless here and Aldkin's Field of Languish - flat area damage reduction on a build that stands still and channels - is the better trade. That reasoning is the specialist's; the pairing itself is one Maxroll and Icy Veins both endorse for Druid.

Plan

Adapted from the Shred Druid's published tree, which is the closest real source - and the adaptation matters, because this build's gearing is genuinely different. It does not need Ifeh's Dire Totem, which exists to enable Shred inside Grizzly Rage, so the Lair Boss tree is worth less here than it is to the meta build. What it does need is paragon levels, because every Spirit-regeneration node is a damage node under the Berú set. So the weighting moves toward Kurast Undercity and The Pit. The Hardcore warning carries over unchanged: avoid Cult of Annihilation.

What is lit7 picks recorded on 4 of 7 activities. Everything else is dimmed, not ruled out: the trees below are the game's own 100 nodes, and a War Plan is per character.
Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

UNTESTED - original theorycraft built as deliberate insurance rather than as a damage maximiser. The meta Shred build is excellent right now but rests on two things Maxroll itself flags as bugs: the Storm Shepherd set's dominance is partly attributed to bugs, and clicking Shred rather than holding it re-triggers the Waxing Gibbous 2-set bonus, which Maxroll calls a mechanical exploit. Exploits get patched. The question this build asks is whether the durable part of the Druid meta - the Berú of the Storm Shepherd rule that damage scales with Spirit regeneration rate - can be harvested by a Storm skill that does not depend on the Shred click interaction at all. Lightning Storm is the candidate: Icy Veins independently rates it S tier, it is already in the meta build's own skill bar as an Orange Herald trigger, and it is a ranged toggle, which also sidesteps Druid's named survivability weakness. If the Shred interaction is patched, this build should be roughly unaffected; if it is not, this build is probably a modest downgrade. That trade is the entire point.

Rotation
  1. Hurricane and Lightning Storm toggled on, group with Azurewrath, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, then kite the pack from range while the storms work.
  2. Refresh Debilitating Roar before it drops and save Earthen Bulwark for the big hit.
  3. No melee exposure, no rapid-clicking.
Variants

Leveling — Hurricane on, Cyclone Armor up, Lightning Storm into packs from range. Wind Shear when Spirit runs out. Stay at range - the whole reason for this build is not being in melee.
Move on when Level 70 with Torment 1 unlocked, and a Berú (Red Wolf Moon as the stand-in) equipped so you can start measuring.

Early Endgame — Hurricane and Lightning Storm toggled on, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, Debilitating Roar refreshed before it drops, Earthen Bulwark before you take a big hit. Note what is absent: no rapid-clicking, no Waxing Gibbous re-trigger, no melee exposure. Run test one here - verify the set scaling actually applies to Lightning Storm before you invest further.
Move on when Test one passed: adding a large Spirit regeneration source visibly increases Lightning Storm's damage. If it did not, stop here and play druid-meta-shred.

Late Endgame — Toggles up, Grizzly Rage on cooldown, kite. Charms: Azurewrath and Godslayer Crown for grouping, Rustbitten Dirk for lair bosses. Mercenary: Raheir with Aldkin as reinforcement - lean defensive, since the whole build is a durability play. Run test two and test three here: Pit clear time and deaths per run, both against druid-meta-shred at matched gear.
Move on when Test two and three recorded. Proceed to pushing regardless of the result - the decisive test is test four, which only happens after the next balance patch.

Pushing — Group with Azurewrath, toggles up, Grizzly Rage, kite the pack while Lightning Storm and Hurricane work. Set an honest expectation: Maxroll rates Lightning Storm A tier for push against Shred's S, so a one-to-two-tier gap versus druid-meta-shred is the expected outcome, not a failure. The build wins its argument only if it holds that position after the next patch while the Shred exploit is fixed.

Reasoning

HypothesisThe Berú of the Storm Shepherd set bonus scales damage with Spirit regeneration rate, and that scaling is a property of the set rather than of Shred specifically. Therefore a Lightning Storm build stacking the same Spirit regeneration sources should capture most of the same scaling while depending on none of the Shred-specific interactions that Maxroll flags as bugged - making it materially more durable across patches, at some cost in peak damage.
Confidencemedium
How to test itTest one: confirm the premise before anything else. Equip Berú of the Storm Shepherd, note your Spirit regeneration rate, then add a single large regen source and check whether Lightning Storm's tooltip or practical damage moves proportionally the way Shred's does. If the set bonus turns out to be Werewolf-gated or Shred-gated in practice, this build has no engine and should be abandoned immediately - that is the single highest-risk assumption here. Test two: compare a Pit clear against druid-meta-shred at identical gear quality; expect to be somewhat slower, and treat anything within a tier or two as success given the durability goal. Test three: deaths per run. This build's secondary claim is that a ranged toggle build survives better than a melee Werewolf build in a class whose survivability is a documented weakness, so count deaths, not just clear time. Test four - the one that actually matters - re-run all of the above after the next balance patch. If the Shred click interaction gets fixed and this build's numbers barely move while the meta build's drop, the thesis is confirmed. Also watch whether Hurricane alone provides enough Spirit regeneration without Shred's attack cadence feeding it, since much of the meta build's regen comes from being in melee constantly.

"Not one of these so-called 'primitives' ever set foot in the Yshari Sanctum, yet they can summon a tempest like whistling for a horse. Perhaps we learned mages don't know everything?" -Iben Fahd

Requires Level 70Druid

Linta of the Storm Shepherd

Set Charm

"Not one of these so-called 'primitives' ever set foot in the Yshari Sanctum, yet they can summon a tempest like whistling for a horse. Perhaps we learned mages don't know everything?" -Iben Fahd

Requires Level 70Druid

Lightning Storm

CoreNature MagicNature Magic StormChanneledHuman

Rank 15/15

Spirit Cost: 0 per period

Lucky Hit Chance: 15%

Conjure a growing lightning storm that deals 65% damage per strike. The number of strikes increases the longer the storm is channeled, up to a maximum of 10 strikes at once. Lightning Storm may grow up to 5 times.

The size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for 4 seconds after channeling.

Modifiers

  • LHero of the StormLightning Storm can be toggled passively and travels with you. Lightning Storm deals 91% damage and will be maintained as long as you have enough Spirit. Cast Lightning Storm again to cancel this effect.
  • Additional StrikesGain 1 additional Lightning Strike. Furthermore, each stack of Ferocity also grants 1 additional Lightning Strike, up to a maximum of 4 additional strikes.
  • Movement SpeedThe size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for an additional 4 seconds after channeling. In addition, you gain a 10%[x] Movement Speed bonus while Lightning Storm's size is preserved.
Lightning Damage

Hurricane

WrathNature MagicNature Magic StormVersatile

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 17%

Form a hurricane around you that deals 360% damage to surrounding enemies over 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • HDerechoHurricane has no cooldown and deals 100%[x] bonus damage. Hurricane costs 15 Spirit per second while active. Cast Hurricane again to toggle the effect off. Hurricane becomes a Core Skill.
  • WeakenEnemies affected by Hurricane are Weakened.
  • Movement SpeedMovement Speed is increased by 10%[x] while Hurricane is active.
  • HVersatileHurricane's damage is increased by 5%[x].
Physical Damage

Earthen Bulwark

DefensiveNature MagicNature Magic EarthVersatile

Rank 9/15

Cooldown: 16 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 30%

Rocks surround you for 6 seconds, granting a Barrier that absorbs 48% of your Maximum Life ({x}) in damage.

Modifiers

  • ETravertine BulwarkEarthen Bulwark grants 3 stacks of Resolve. In addition, Earthen Bulwark summons Tectonic Spikes that deal 150% total damage to enemies around you.
  • UnstoppableCasting Earthen Bulwark makes you Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
  • Fortify and HealingYou are Fortified for 7% per second while Earthen Bulwark is active. In addition, Heal for 15% of your Maximum Life if Earthen Bulwark is fully depleted from damage.
Physical Damage

Debilitating Roar

DefensiveShapeshiftingBearShout

Rank 5/15

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Shapeshift into a Werebear and bellow a mighty roar reducing Nearby enemies' damage dealt by 25% for 3.4 seconds.

Modifiers

  • DBooming RoarAll Debilitating Roar's effects and durations are increased by 50%.
  • Increased DurationIncrease the duration of Debilitating Roar by 1 second or 3 seconds if you are Fortified.
  • WerebearDebilitating Roar reduces Nearby enemies' damage dealt by an additional 5%.

Cyclone Armor

DefensiveNature MagicNature Magic StormVersatile

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 12 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 25%

Passive: Powerful winds surround you, granting a 10.0% bonus to All Resistances.

Active: The winds rapidly expand, Knocking Back enemies and dealing 30% damage.

Modifiers

  • Increased RadiusActive: Cyclone Armor's radius is increased by 50%.
  • ResistancePassive: Gain an additional 20%[+] bonus to All Resistances.
  • CReversalThe active winds are reversed pulling enemies towards you instead. In addition, the area of effect is increased by 30%[x].
  • CVersatileCyclone Armor's damage and Non-Physical Damage Reduction are increased by 5%[x].
Physical Damage

Grizzly Rage

UltimateShapeshiftingBear

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 120 seconds

Shapeshift into a Dire Werebear for 27.0 seconds becoming Berserk and gaining +20% bonus Armor.

Modifiers

  • GCornered BeastYour damage is increased by 5%[x] (max. 200%[x]) each time you take or deal damage with a skill while Grizzly Rage is active.
  • Cooldown ReductionReduces the cooldown of Grizzly Rage by 20 seconds.
Physical Damage

Unique Helm

  • ○+{x} Maximum Life
  • ○{x} Cooldown Reduction
  • ○+{x} Resistance to All Elements
  • ○+{x} Maximum Resource[15 – 20]
  • ✦Tempered: +{x} Maximum Life (Worldly Endurance)

Provoke

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 25 seconds

Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.

Ground Slam

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Round Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Strike

Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir swings a round shield at enemies, dealing 85% Physical damage. Every 20 swings, Raheir Heals you for 8% of your Maximum Life.

Shield Charge

Core skillRaheir

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Tower Shield

Basic Attack: Shield Bash

Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Raheir bashes enemies with a tower shield, dealing 80% Physical damage and Fortifying you for 0.2% of your Maximum Life.

Crater

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst deals 40% more Physical damage and additionally Stuns enemies for 2 seconds.

Raheir's Guard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15%[+] Armor.

Vanguard

PassiveRaheir

Raheir Slows surrounding enemies by 40%.

Mocking Lure

PassiveRaheir

You deal 15%[x] increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.

Iron Wolf's Ward

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Iron Wolf's Call

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal 25%[x] increased damage and cost no Resource.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 25%.

Sundering Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's final Crater burst deals 200%[x] increased damage and inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.

Shield Throw

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.

Iron Wolf's Arrival

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw.

Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Consecrated Shield

PassiveRaheir

Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.

Bastion

Iconic skillRaheir

Cooldown: 30 seconds

Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds.

Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1.0 seconds.

Iron Wolf's Virtue

PassiveRaheir

When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life.

Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.

Inspiration

PassiveRaheir

Enemies affected by Raheir's Ground Slam take 15%[x] increased damage.

Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal 25%[x] increased damage.

Raheir's Aegis

PassiveRaheir

Raheir grants you 15% Resistance to All Elements.

Draw Fire

PassiveRaheir

When you use a Healing Potion, Raheir Taunts enemies around him for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 20 seconds.

Tree of Plenty

Tree of Whispers

The Tree offers a fourth Whisper Cache choice.

Headrotten Feast

Tree of Whispers

Headrotten Bosses that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 Monster Power, and will always drop a Whisper Cache.

Resplendent Favor

Tree of Whispers

Each Whisper Cache has a chance to drop a Resplendent Spark.

Malignant Invasion

Tree of Whispers

Varshan can now appear in a Whisper Ambushes.

Slay Varshan to earn the contents of an Ancestral Collection of Chaos .

Grim Retribution

Tree of Whispers

Completing a Whisper has a chance to trigger a Whisper Ambush.

These enemies have a chance to burst out the contents of a Collection of Chaos when slain.

Roots of Power

Tree of Whispers

Enemies that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 Monster Power.

Planting Corrupted Roots in Helltides yields double rewards.

Colossal Foe

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Ambushes sometimes include Bosses.

These Bosses will always burst out the contents of a Greater Collection of Chaos when slain.

Simple Gifts

Tree of Whispers

The Tree only offers one Whisper Cache choice that will always be a Material Collection or a Collection of Chaos.

Corrupted Roots

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Caches sometimes contain Corrupted Roots.

Plant Corrupted Roots to grow an Exposed Root. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies.

The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.

Wisdom of Whispers

Tree of Whispers

Gain 50% more Experience Orbs in Whisper Caches.

Fortune or Famine

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Caches from the Tree of Whispers are always at least of Greater Quality... or Junk.

Material Wealth

Tree of Whispers

The Tree now only offers Material Collections.

Grim Mysteries

Tree of Whispers

Collections of Chaos are replaced with Collections of Mysteries.

These caches can drop anything.

Chaotic Favor

Tree of Whispers

Completing a Whisper has a small chance to award a Collection of Chaos.

Branching Pathways

Nightmare Dungeons

When advancing to the next dungeon in a Nightmare Escalation, 2 additional Horadric Portals appear.

Fearless Conviction

Nightmare Dungeons

While in a Nightmare Dungeon, killing Elites and Champions grants you stacks of Conviction.

Getting hit by an Elite or Champion causes you to lose a stack of Conviction.

A Conviction Chest appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining Conviction. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award Attuned Primordial Dust.

Goblinfall

Nightmare Dungeons

Treasure Goblins have a small chance to drop a Nightmare Sigil with the Treasure Breach affix.

Nemesis

Nightmare Dungeons

Activating a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon causes up to 7 Elites to ambush you.

Gauntlet

Nightmare Dungeons

While in a Nightmare Dungeon, slaying an enemy while empowered by a Shrine traps their soul within you.

When the Shrine buff expires, all trapped souls escape and spawn around you as renewed enemies.

Souls will be lost when moving between dungeons in an Escalation Dungeon.

Horadric Hunter

Nightmare Dungeons

Kill 25 Elites across Nightmare Dungeons to reveal a Horadric Altar. Activating it results in one of the following outcomes:

Summon Elites

Summon Treasure Goblins

Summon The Butcher

Gain Riches

Terrible Misfortune

Altar of Avarice

Nightmare Dungeons

Horadric Altars are replaced with Goblin Altars that only summon Treasure Goblins.

Cipher Maps

Nightmare Dungeons

Whenever you would reveal a Horadric Altar, you reveal 2 instead.

Rewarded Faith

Nightmare Dungeons

Gain a random additional buff when claiming a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon.

Greed is Good

Nightmare Dungeons

Killing a Treasure Goblin in a Nightmare Dungeon has a small chance to spawn a portal that takes you to the Goblin's Retreat.

Waking Spoils

Nightmare Dungeons

After completing a Nightmare Dungeon, a War's Bounty Chest will spawn that grants additional rewards.

Recurring Nightmare

Nightmare Dungeons

Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons gain +1 Monster Power and have a chance to drop an Escalation Sigil when slain.

Escalation Sigils can only appear in Torment+ difficulty.

Dread Revival

Nightmare Dungeons

Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons have a chance to revive when slain.

Night Terrors

Helltide

You have a chance to be ambushed by Hellborne in Nightmare Dungeons.

Hellborne have a small chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.

Hell's Prize

Helltide

Hell's Prize chests will now appear in Helltide.

These chests offer a massive torrent of items for 666 Aberrant Cinders.

Fall of the Fell

Helltide

Harbingers will emerge from falling meteors twice as often, and drop twice as many Aberrant Cinders when slain.

Harbingers in Helltide have +1 Monster Power.

Meat Brothers

Helltide

Instead of Hellborne, two Butchers that are connected with flaming chains ambush you.

These Butchers each have a high chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.

Hellmouth

Helltide

When a Hellwyrm emerges, it unleashes one of the following:

A Chaos Rift, which releases varied rewards upon collapse.

Maggots, which burst out Experience Orbs when slain.

Bloodseekers, which are more likely to drop Ancestral items when slain.

Wretched Vermin

Helltide

Demonic Rats will frequently attack you in Helltide.

Ashes to Ashes

Helltide

On death, lose all your Aberrant Cinders.

For every 100 Aberrant Cinders you pick up, you gain an additional 10.

Undying Embers

Helltide

You lose no Aberrant Cinders on death.

Infernal Rite

Helltide

Ambushes spawn up to four additional Hellborne.

Hellborne have a higher chance to drop Unique items when slain.

Planar Tremors

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always open a Chaos Rift, and enemies that emerge from it gain +1 Monster Power.

The first time a Chaos Rift opens, there is a chance that another will open.

Tainted Shrines

Helltide

While empowered by a Shrine in Helltide, slain enemies grant double the progress to your Threat Level.

Hated Foe

Helltide

Maximum Threat enemies that ambush you gain +1 Monster Power.

Chaotic Echoes

Helltide

Collapsed Chaos Rifts have a chance to reopen.

Bursting Brood

Helltide

Maggots and Pangs of Duriel explode when killed and will often drop Boss Trophies.

Writhe and Rot

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always spew Maggots that gain +1 Monster Power.

Sometimes, a Pang of Duriel will also crawl forth. Lair Keys often burst out of Pangs of Duriel.

Bound by Blood

Helltide

Bloodseekers are connected with flaming chains.

When slain, Bloodseekers drop items that match the category of the last opened Tortured Gift.

Crimson Scent

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always call forth Bloodseekers that gain +1 Monster Power.

Greater Bloodseekers may also emerge, which have a high chance to drop Legendary items when slain.

Idols of War

The Undercity

Greater Tributes of Armament more frequently drop throughout Sanctuary and have an additional Bargain choices.

Trials and Tributes

The Undercity

For each Portal Prankster you slay within the Undercity, a Tribute Chest appears after killing the District Boss.

Tribute Chests are unlocked by offering a Tribute.

Gutter Filth

The Undercity

When you activate any Beacon within the Undercity, there is a small chance to summon a Portal Prankster.

Invasion Portals will sometimes summon Rats of varying amounts.

Endless Swarm

The Undercity

Invasion Portals now appear in the Undercity.

The enemies that emerge grant Attunement when slain.

Jade Epiphany

The Undercity

When you gain an Attunement level in the Undercity, Experience Orbs appear around you.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Finely Tuned

The Undercity

Gain additional Tuning Prisms when completing the Undercity at maximum Attunement.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Pathfinder

The Undercity

When you reach maximum Attunement, a portal to the final floor of the Undercity appears.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Unfortunate Souls

The Undercity

Invasion Portals can now summon Wisps that attach to you and vanish if you die.

Each Wisp you save will reward you with Forgotten Souls and other Crafting Materials at the end of the run.

Initiative

The Undercity

When you find the District Boss you gain the Initiative buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining Time. Initiative is lost upon death.

If you slay the District Boss with Initiative active, you receive Tribute rewards as if your Attunement was 2 higher (max 6).

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Last Gasp

The Undercity

Time collected from slain enemies with 5 seconds or less remaining in the Undercity doubles the Time earned.

Bauble Day

The Undercity

If you slay a Portal Prankster within the Undercity, the Cabochon Merchant will appear after killing the District Boss.

The Cabochon Merchant will sell you Runes and Gems for Gold.

Lair of Plenty

Lair Bosses

Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power.

Gain +1 Hoard Chest when you slay a Lair Boss (excluding Belial).

Infernal Deception

Lair Bosses

Belial can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.

Two by Two

Lair Bosses

After opening a Hoard Chest, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the Nemesis Lair, where you will fight two Initiate Lair Bosses at the same time.

Slaying both will yield great rewards.

You cannot enter a Nemesis Lair from Belial's throne room.

Nemesis Tides

Lair Bosses

Initiate Lair Bosses have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events.

Killing Lair Bosses in Helltides while earning the Event Mastery grants many random Lair Boss materials.

This only occurs in Torment+ difficulties.

Exotic Armory

Lair Bosses

Hoard Chests drop one additional Unique Item, but it can be for any Class.

Greater Nemesis

Lair Bosses

After completing a Nemesis Lair, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a Greater Nemesis Lair. Within this heinous place lies two Greater Lair Bosses.

Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.

Lair of Runes

Lair Bosses

Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power.

Lair Bosses have a higher chances of dropping specific Runes.

Ultimate Nemesis

Lair Bosses

After defeating all Bosses within the Greater Nemesis Lair, the Call Of Evil will appear. This altar will accept 3 Superior Lair Keys and open a Portal that takes you to the Ultimate Nemesis Lair.

Inside the Ultimate Nemesis Lair, all enemies gain +5 Monster Power. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 Hoard Chests worth of Items.

Golden Hoard

Lair Bosses

All equipment that would drop from Hoard Chests are converted to Gold, except for Unique and Mythic items.

Grigoire's Gambit

Lair Bosses

After opening a Tortured Gift in Helltides, there is a chance Grigoire's knights will ambush you.

When killed in Helltide, they may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.

Duriel's Invasion

Lair Bosses

When summoning the Blood Maiden in Helltides, there is a chance Duriel can be summoned instead.

Killing Duriel in Helltides can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

Out of the Cold

Lair Bosses

When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Beast in Ice has a chance to appear and attack you.

When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop Unique Items from the Beast in Ice's Hoard Chest.

Children of Zir

Lair Bosses

When exploring the Pit, Lord Zir's Bloodseekers can now ambush you.

Killing them in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

Dog of Astaroth

Lair Bosses

When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Amalgam of Rage has a chance to appear and attack you.

Killing the Amalgam of Rage in Nightmare Dungeons can drop Unique Items associated with Astaroth

Embers of Anguish

Lair Bosses

When exploring the Pit, Embers of Anguish can appear. Activating one drops Progress Orbs, and causes Andariel to ambush you at the end of the Pit.

Killing Andariel in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from her Hoard Chest.

Blood of Bartuc

Lair Bosses

The Fell Council in the Infernal Hordes has +1 Monster Power.

After defeating the Fell Council, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items associated with Bartuc.

Varshan's Vengeance

Lair Bosses

Varshan and his minions can now appear in a Chaos Wave within the Infernal Hordes.

After killing Varshan in the Infernal Hordes, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.

Exalted Council

Infernal Hordes

Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 Monster Power and drop additional items when slain.

Council Coffers

Infernal Hordes

The Chest of Talismans will appear after defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc.

Infernal Hoard

Infernal Hordes

Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.

Forged in Flame

Infernal Hordes

Obducite drops instead of Gem Fragments in the Infernal Hordes.

Flawless Find

Infernal Hordes

Gem Fragments drop instead of Obducite in the Infernal Hordes.

Method and Madness

Infernal Hordes

Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.

Impending Doom

Infernal Hordes

When the current wave has 10 seconds remaining, Aether Events spawn at all locations.

The Black Pact

Infernal Hordes

An ominous altar appears between waves in the Infernal Hordes.

It can be invoked only once, and provides an Infernal Offering that shares a category with your previous choice.

Reign in Hell

Infernal Hordes

An additional Infernal Offering appears each wave.

However, you suppress Chaos Waves from appearing.

Total Chaos

Infernal Hordes

Chaos Waves appear more frequently.

However, one less Infernal Offering appears each wave.

Bedlam

Infernal Hordes

When you enter a Chaos Wave, gain +50 Aether and all enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.

Pulse of Aether

Infernal Hordes

Suppressing a Chaos Wave grants +50 Aether.

All enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.

Cult of Annihilation

Infernal Hordes

Doomsayers appear during the Infernal Hordes.

Doomsayers are dangerous enemies but also drop Aether.

Scale of Tathamet

Infernal Hordes

Once per wave the Scale of Tathamet may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the Infernal Hordes.

Devil's Deal

Infernal Hordes

At the start of the Infernal Hordes, gain an Infernal Challenge.

Completing the Infernal Challenge will grant +200 Aether.

Choron's Haste

The Pit

The Pit gains the Haste Mastery objective.

When you kill the Guardian gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for every 5 minutes left on the Timer.

Damned Thieves

The Pit

Orb Thieves have a chance to spawn in The Pit.

Orb Thieves drop an immense amount of Progress Orbs when killed, but leave a trail of Traps in their wake.

Heart of Stone

The Pit

Begin The Pit carrying the Heart of Stone, a fragile relic that is dropped after taking sustained damage and breaks after dropping 10 times.

While you carry it, enemies can drop bonus Progress Orbs.

After slaying the Guardian, Choron's Pedestal appears. Deposit the Heart of Stone within to gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance.

Choron's Blessing

The Pit

Gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for completing The Pit.

Choron's Favor

The Pit

Special events and encounters become more common in higher Difficulty Tiers of The Pit.

Choron's Soul

The Pit

Choron's Soul now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Soul will drop 1 Progress Orb per Glyph Upgrade Chance offered.

All Progress Orbs in The Pit now grant Experience.

Choron's Flesh

The Pit

Choron's Flesh now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Flesh will allow you to get valuable Equipment by consuming one of your Glyph Upgrade Chances.

Choron's Shortcut

The Pit

Choron's Portal randomly appears in The Pit.

When used, it will send you to the entrance to the next Pit Floor, or become Unstable and summon either an Elite or a Shrine.

Cursed Rituals

The Pit

Different Ritual Sites now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:

Choron's Blood appears in foliage dense regions

Choron's Sweat appears in stony locations

Choron's Tears appears in mystical places

Sacrificing these Materials at Ritual Sites may grant Gold, Materials, Items, and more.

Pit Butcher

The Pit

The Butcher has a chance to appear anywhere in The Pit.

The Butcher is a Guardian and killing him will complete the run.

However, you fail the run if he kills any player.

Cursed Merchant

The Pit

The Cursed Merchant has a chance to appear when completing the Pit.

The Cursed Merchant will sell Equipment for Artificers Stones.

Cursed Offerings

The Pit

Cursed Machines have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit.

Cursed Machines cost Artificers Stones to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies.

The more Cursed Machines you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.

Choron's Wager

The Pit

Choron's Wager can appear in The Pit.

Activate it with Artificer's Stones to acquire a challenge, which grants a large amount of Artificer's Stones when completed.
